assets.name: hk_tank_A
assets.prompt: A 6-cell sprite sheet of ONE character. Six poses reading left to right then top to bottom: standing at the ready, weapon held naturally, weight settled; then mid-stride moving left foot forward, body leaning into the run; then the opposite stride, right side forward; then the weapon drawn far back, body coiled and loaded to strike; then the strike swung all the way through to full extension, body committed forward; then casting a quick secondary ability with the off-hand, energy gathering around it.

assets.name: hk_tank_B
assets.prompt: A 6-cell sprite sheet of ONE character. Six poses reading left to right then top to bottom: crouching low beginning an evasive dash, body compressing; then tucked tight mid-dash, motion streaks behind; then landing low from the dash, one hand touching the ground; then recoiling hard from a hit, head snapped back, limbs flung wide; then staggering down onto one knee, barely holding up; then collapsed on the ground, weapon fallen beside, utterly still.

assets.name: hk_tank_C
assets.prompt: The character standing firm and braced, surrounded by a swirling pale aura wrapping the whole body — a translucent glow of light and sparks signalling brief invulnerability.
